description: An entirely invented rural retreat on flat, 180-by-180-metre ground. Three small hut groups follow successive path bends along the western and northern margins. A broad, irregular central clearing remains unobstructed, with long views toward a small eastern pond. Loose edge groves frame rather than fill the clearing. All placements, geometry and descriptive claims are authored fiction.

imaginary.brief: Create Mossbell Retreat, an imaginary woodland clearing on a flat 180 metre square. This should feel open and rural, not urban: only five small huts, a shared pavilion, a narrow meandering footpath, a small irregular pond, and groups of trees of varied size concentrated at the edges and in a few loose groves. Use 24–32 total objects. Keep a generous irregular central clearing and three small hut groups following the path, with orientations reflecting the local bend. Avoid grids, evenly spaced trees, giant straight boulevards and urban density. Keep dry buildings and tree trunks clear of water and routes. Simple authored geometry is sufficient; a memorable little pavilion may use a few normalized parts. All geometry and claims are invented.
